observation.visible_scene: A close-up view of a metalworking task, specifically cleaning or chipping a weld seam on a dark metal beam. The beam is clamped to a wooden slatted surface with a rusty C-clamp. A person's lower leg, wearing blue jeans and a dark shoe, is visible resting near the beam, and their hand, encased in a thick tan leather glove, holds a metal tool.
visible_changes: The gloved hand performs a rapid, repetitive striking or scraping motion along the weld seam using the metal tool.
The tool's movement is fast enough to cause significant motion blur in many frames, alternating between being raised and contacting the metal surface.
The point of contact on the weld seam shifts slightly along the length of the beam over the course of the clip.
The person's foot, the metal beam, and the C-clamp remain completely stationary throughout the sequence.
outside_clip_unknowns: The specific type of welding used to create the seam.
The broader context of the construction or fabrication project.
What happens immediately before the clip starts or after it ends.
uncertain_details: The exact identity of the tool (appears to be a chipping hammer or weld cleaning brush).
The precise material of the beam (likely steel).
